package_name: CTID Micro - File Access and File Modification
description: Focused CTID micro emulation for File Access and File Modification. It runs a labeled Morgana-native behavior simulation while retaining provenance for upstream source and asset candidates.
summary: This micro emulation plan targets the [DS0022 File: File Access](https://attack.mitre.org/datasources/DS0022/#File%20Access) and [DS0022 File: File Modification](https://attack.mitre.org/datasources/DS0022/#File%20Modification) data sources. It covers file interactions like reading a file and modifying a file’s contents, permissions, or attributes. Ransomware attacks typically show a combination of file access and modification conducted at a rapid pace. This behavior is not unique to ransomware
purpose: Validate defensive telemetry and controls for the compound File Access and File Modification behavior rather than testing one command in isolation.
capabilities: Preserves the CTID File Access and File Modification defensive objective and source documentation as a focused Morgana Chain.
Preserves ATT&CK coverage and defensive intent as a focused Morgana Chain.
Runs an operational sandboxed simulation until a reviewed release asset is pinned with SHA256 and license provenance.
use_cases: Plan a repeatable detection-validation exercise for File Access and File Modification.
Review required telemetry and environmental prerequisites before approving the upstream tool.
Compare detections for compound discovery behavior with isolated Atomic or Stockpile procedures.
safety_notes: This package dispatches a labeled Morgana-native simulation, never an unreviewed upstream executable.
Use an explicitly authorized lab suitable for File Access and File Modification; source behavior may alter system or security state.
Pin a specific release asset, license, size, platform, architecture, and SHA256 before enabling automation.
author: MITRE CTID / X3M.AI conversion

prerequisites: Explicitly authorized lab suitable for File Access and File Modification

scripts.description: Executable Morgana-native simulation of File Access and File Modification. Upstream executable or build output has not yet been pinned, licensed, hashed, and approved for Camelot redistribution.
scripts.command: Write-Output '[START] CTID simulation T1005'; $simulationRoot = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'Morgana\CTID'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $simulationRoot -Force | Out-Null; $artifactPath = Join-Path $simulationRoot 'CTID-001-t1005.txt'; $collectionDir = Join-Path $simulationRoot 'collection'; New-Item -ItemType Directory $collectionDir -Force | Out-Null; 1..3 | ForEach-Object { Set-Content (Join-Path $collectionDir "sample-$_.txt") "CTID sample data $_" }; Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $collectionDir '*') -DestinationPath (Join-Path $simulationRoot 'collection.zip') -Force; Get-Item (Join-Path $simulationRoot 'collection.zip'); Write-Output '[SUCCESS] CTID simulation T1005 family=collection';
